learning_outcomes.text: Introduce the meaning of quality assurance and the ways to achieve it, quality assurance systems and standards, and convey the difficulties experienced in implementing these systems.
Explain the definition and indicator of quality, the reasons for poor quality, and how quality can be measured.

Provide a brief historical overview of how quality has been ensured from the past to the present, by addressing methods to prevent poor quality, acceptable error margins, and reasons for inadequate quality control.

Explain what Quality Assurance means and how it can be achieved, the conditions necessary for a successful quality assurance system, implementation difficulties, and methods to overcome these difficulties.
Explain the standards related to Quality Assurance, and the content of ISO 9000 and ISO 9001.

syllabus_topics: Procedures, Forms and Instructions Explained with Examples
Evolution of Quality and Definitions of Quality
Responsibilities of Employees in the Quality System
Importance of Human Relations in Quality
10 Things To Do and Not To Do
